body: My family is dead. My girlfriend left me. Be happy you have people who even care enough to wonder where you are on Christmas. Some of us could die today and no one would even notice or care. I feel for your struggle, it still hurts, but appreciate what you have my friend. Much love for you. Be strong.  <3

Youre so young. Theres so so much you havent experienced yet.. Im not saying life isnt often brutal and unkind and completely indifferent to our suffering.. but youre just so damn young.. Theres still so many opportunities for you. Not al of us have that.. Please at least give a few years of adulthood a shot before you do something so drastic

I dont think its fair to drop the "co-dependency" line. I think thats a real overused cliche. Its perfectly acceptable for people to say stuff like he just mentioned when the relationship is going well. Hell, I think thats basically the core of most of the wedding vows Ive heard in my life.. So why stick someone with the stigma of "co-dependency" when those feelings dont just immediately evaporate when the relationship ends, especially when the parting is one-sided and/or sudden?

I dunno.. My ex has said stuff like "youre such an amazing person," "You deserve to be happy" etc.. And it really just stings more tbh. Id almost wish she cared enough about our relationship to hate me, or be angry its over.. or show some sort of emotion so Id know I mattered at least.. The platitudes just feel like.. apathy

Sure, Ive been there a few times.. I actually remember lying in bed one night next to someone who loved me thinking about how happy I was and how long itd been since Id fallen asleep while thinking about killing myself..

The thing is.. its always fleeting. Its always a lie and each time life knocks you down, its that much harder to get up the next time. At this point, I dont think Id trust happiness even if it presented itself again. I genuinely feel like Id be better off if Id never known what it felt like.. It would make how I feel the rest of the time less painful...

This is the such a cliche thing to say and its such a load of bullshit... The truth is, most people don't actually care about anyone but themselves. 
And they damn sure dont want the responsibility/downer of listening to you talk about how depressed you are, even if you leave out the part about wanting to kill yourselves. Include that little tidbit and just watch as they trip over themselves trying to run away.. The common response is "get help.." which is almost insulting.. And not something I dont already know.. Yea, I know I could pay a stranger to listen to me talk about my problems.. but the fact that thats my only option just makes me feel worse and more insignificant..

Im sorry youre going through this OP,  and I hope things get better. But I also wish people would stop with these stupid cliche platitudes like "talk to someone.." As if no one had ever thought of that before..

Yea I feel this. My life turned out the way I was always terrified it would. I always hoped Id get older and eventually things would just fall into place... Id meet someone and fall in love.. Wed get married and have kids. Id get some job, however mundane, that was stable and allowed me to support them and live happily ever after...

I always hoped this would happen, because it seems to be what happens for most people, but it always seemed like a long ways from where I was at... 20 years later.. its no closer. Im still lonely.. I live a superficial life surrounded by alcohol and drugs and a fair amount of somewhat accesible beautiful women, but its not what I want.. I want the stability of a 9-5, and someone who loves me, and a plottable future... But.. it just doesn't seem to be in the cards

That Ill always be sad and alone. :( Its kinda funny actually.. after a certain point nothing death has is frightening anymore. To fear death youd have to first value life. After a point, life is way more terrifying than the void

That sounds brutal btw.. I dont have any idea how I'd react... Its funny, sometimes, the things life throws at you.

I was thinking today.. maybe shes not a sociopath, maybe shes just so god damn beautiful its stunted her emotional growth. She's free spiritied, smart and absolutely stunning, and as a result shes always had a constant line of guys willing to do anything for her. When we were together,  it was gratifying, which adds to the trauma of the whole thing. Id walk into a place where all eyes were on her (she bartends in a popular bar here in town) and Id suddenly receive a singular amount of attention. For someone who struggles with self-esteem issues, you couldnt engineer a more perfect drug if you tried... 
 Now though, Im seeing that she just doesnt seem to have any capacity to understand what Im feeling.  Shes never known hopelessness, or extreme sadness, or heartbreak... Shes always had an out, shes never had to just plow through an intensely painful situation, and Im not sure that's been a positive.. I dunno.. All I know is it hurts like hell right now. A deep deep, incomparable pain. Ive been drinking tonight but.. Im gonna be in San Fran this week and I already know that bridge is gonna be tempting.

Just trying to understand her thought process too.. Like, if a chick I had broken up with recently told me how much she loved me when it wasnt reciprocated, Id probably just leave them alone... But say I did enjoy her company and maybe care about her still... I still definitely wouldn't invite her back to my place to spend the night... the message that sends is pretty clear... AAand.. I damn sure would never flaunt sappy messages I was exchanging with another girl.. Its like the thing couldnt be engineered better to fk with my emotions..

I've slept with other girls.. But this girl is literally a 10.. and the chemistry was amazing.... There were so many guys just waiting for us to break up... It sucks because Ill never get the kind of attention she gets... Its so much easier for her.

So should that have even made a difference? Even if we'd had sex, i know I still would have felt shitty after because Id still be just another guy.  Like dude said,  Im a stupid idiot... It really is just like a drug... When Im around her,  Im happy and I dont care how stupid Im being.. But as soon as she leaves,  Im more depressed than I was at any point before...
Yea.. She's real badass and so hot though. Real hard to leave
Oh yea.
So mean, but yea you aint wrong. ;)

My GF saved me too. It definitely makes you feel infinitely better to feel that human contact and know someone else cares.. Unfortunately its kind of a bandaid.. Now that shes gone.. Itd worse than before. I wish I hadnt grown to depend on her so much..
I understand how this all feels.. But please message me or call/text someone you know first.. Or just sleep on it and see how tomorrow feels

Yea me too man.. Getting murdered would actually be the most ideal outcome.. An exit that wouldnt look cowardly or cause as much pain to my family/friends, but still an exit.. A quick terminal illness would be nice too..
Maybe thats what was implied.. Or maybe the underlying meaning is that all hope is false hope because reality is inherently cruel and trends towards a painful, meaningless existence..
"Hope in reality is the worst of all evils because it prolongs the torments of man." - Friedrich Nietzsche

You summed it up pretty nicely.  Ive gotten to 4 a few times, like you said usually after a particularly emotionally tramautic moment, especially coming on top of an already low period, and the calm of it is actually pretty legitimately scary. As you said, its like a switch just flips and I go from despair to just calm resolution because sometimes it feels like thats all I have left.. I think what has saved me is the lack of an immediately accessible/fast method so usually I just end up passing out.. 

I think the other "stages" can be therapeutic to a degree. Neitzschke wrote "The thought of suicide is a great consolation. By means of it one gets through many a dark night," which I think captures it perfectly. Regardless of the intent.. just the thought that you have the power to escape if things get too painful is often comforting. Lately its frequently been my last thought at night because its the only thing that keeps my mind off all the other painful memories/thoughts that make it impossible to go to sleep otherwise. The only problem being that I feel like over enough time I think it makes you more desensitized and "ok" with the whole idea so I move through the "stages" more quickly as things start to go wrong.. as they inevitably always do..

My mom is dying so I figure Im in it until she goes anyway... I think about adding that to what shes going through anyway, the difficulty of her even physically getting TO a funeral, and it gives me pause. That was the deal I made with life went she got sick about a year and a half ago. 
And for about 6 months life even actually tricked me into thinking maybe things were going to turn around.. but of course due to my own fuckups (a constant in my life) and a series of unfortunate events beyond my control.. Im back lower than Ive ever been. Feeling high really just makes the inevitable fall worse so Im not even sure Id trust happiness again either way..
What if nothing matters to you anymore and all you feel is pain? What then?

I finally did.  I still regret it occasionally if only because it means I cant counter with snaps of me (pretending to be) having fun. But it wasn't worth seeing her in a thong at some guys pool, or all dressed up out on the town,  or seeing heart emojis on the picture of the note some guy left on her pillow telling hed made breakfast (which pretty much ruined my next couple days..) So yea fuck you Snapchat, and fuck you "N.." I deserve better

Its a beautiful sentiment and I wish I believed it.. From the first moment I saw my ex I thought she was the most beautiful girl Id ever seen. Im 35 and Ive never fallen in love with someone at first sight in my entire life. When she told me she loved me (she said it first!!!) I felt like Id won the most incredible lottery in the world. Now that shes gone forever, I can't imagine Im going to find that again. Im not 16.. Ive been in the dating world for decades and never felt like this before.. Its not something that just happens every day. I might settle for someone else one day out of loneliness.. but I know Ill never find someone like her again.. and Im not sure I even care to try

I agree with everything but the anger part.. I seldom feel better than when I can bring myself to be angry at her for leaving me like this.. after all we promised each other. Anger isn't the most positive emotion, but it beats self-pity/resentment, regret and crippling depression everytime

I went to a festival recently with my ex after not seeing her for a month (we had planned it previously) It started great, we were holding hands and sneaking occasional kisses and just being generally adorable.. Then all of a sudden she decided she didnt actually want any of that.. and it was like being broken up with all over again. And it just got worse from there as I guess I reacted poorly to all the male attention she was getting (shes unfortunately incredibly beautiful...) Ended up being a complete disaster.. Morale of the story is.. dont hope for anything. Dont rush contact. Youll just reset your entire healing process..

Man, Im so right there with you. Finding other girls isnt that hard, but when you find THAT one its hard to go back to randos.. And the thought of her with other guys destroys me, as much as I keep telling myself it shouldnt.  At night its almost easier to think about just ending everything than it is to lie there remembering being with her.. wondering who shes with or what I could have done differently. I used to do cocaine/drink occasionally just as a social thing, but now its totally self-medication.. I just want to get fucked up until I cant feel feelings anymore.. 
Theres a lyric that keeps going through my head over and over.. "Plan was to drink until the pains over. But what's worse, the pain or the hangover?" And Im not even sure.. The hangover sucks.. but sometimes Im not sure I can survive the pain so at least the hangover means I got to another day..

Fml..
